arguments.text: S1 (18C, tide -0.24 to +0.18 turning ~min30, sea breeze to 11kt behind on way out). Warm-up at 52 spm: HR 115, ~9-10 bpm above model at pace power with zero current; pace share 0.45 vs HR 0.54. Matching would need ~-0.13 m/s current, close to forecast -0.18. Set current_before_first_turn -0.15. Blade efficiency curve steep 48-56 spm (pace uncertain at low rates).

Main stretch 63 spm: HR ~0.70, pace ~0.76 (boundary endurance/tempo). route_gap: cp_scale if HR right 1.02, hr offset if pace right -1 bpm -> routes roughly agree. Paddler: Fine.

arguments.text: S1 min28: stretch 23-33 at 65 spm: HR 0.755 vs pace 0.88 (HR 13 bpm under model at pace power). Computer current still -0.08 but forecast says tide turned + sea breeze behind on way out -> true current ~+0.05..+0.1 with boat: pace over-reads on out leg. Switched to hr_first. HR model fit well in settled current (min 14-18 both ~0.70, gap ~0 bpm). Lesson: computer current lags tide turn/breeze; HR at 18C reliable for this paddler so far.

arguments.text: S1 min40: with true current near computer value (back legs min14-18, 30-32, 34-37) HR and pace agree within ~0.03 incl threshold (HR ~1.02 vs pace 0.97-1.03, HR peak 174). Out legs after tide turn: pace over-reads 0.1-0.13 (computer current lags, still -0.04 while paddler says water moves with us). HR settles fast (tau 30s) even after threshold. This paddler: HR model trustworthy at 18C, fresh. Keep hr_first in changing current.

text: Heart rate stays first: the computer still thinks the current is against on the way out, but the paddler says it now runs with them.
Heart rate first; no other change.

Warm-up 52 spm: HR on model at zero-current pace (gap ~0), HR 0.52 vs pace 0.58 with -0.11 assumed. Paddler: Good. Watch heat: HR raised + extra creep over the long stretch -> may need hr_extra_creep or pace_first once current known (steady tide, light wind = computer estimate should be good).

text: Both routes agree on endurance; reading from both.

text: Strap reads plausibly again; routes agree on endurance.
No guide change.

arguments.text: S2 min40: steady ~100-105 W pace at 61 spm all stretch; pace share 0.62-0.63 flat, HR share drifting 0.60 -> 0.55-0.58 (HR +7 bpm min10->40 vs model creep +12). HR creep less than calibrated (~2.5 vs 4 /10min) in this session; agree mode averaging keeps endurance. Considered hr_extra_creep -1.5, not set (S1 end agreed with model).

text: Both routes still endurance; heart rate creeps a little less than the model expects, the average holds the right zone.
No guide change.

arguments.text: S3 (20C, near-zero tide, light wind; intervals 4 min on / 2 off from min 8 to 36, cool-down 38-43). Paddler: Good. Warm-up 52 spm again HR +6..10 bpm above model at zero-current pace (both extrapolated below 88 W, low-rate blade efficiency uncertain) - recurring warm-up pattern, not scored. Set assumed current -0.03.

text: Assumed near-zero current; reading from both routes.

arguments.text: S3 interval 1 (min 8-12, 67 spm, ~190 W pace): pace 1.16-1.20, HR 1.09-1.10 (HR 170, near model ceiling 172; power above HR-model fit range 88-167 W, extrapolated). Both above threshold. Current ~-0.04 (out 3.04, back 3.12). Watch: HR capped near ceiling, pace under-reads with fatigue in later intervals.

text: Both routes read above threshold in the first interval; no change.

arguments.text: S3 min23: gusty headwind building on the nose on way out (paddler); computer current -0.10..-0.14, pace noisy. Intervals: int1 pace 1.18/HR 1.10, int2 1.10/1.05, int3 ~1.09/1.05. HR at 168-172 = model ceiling 172; with creep HR compresses above ~1.05 (S1 threshold HR=pace). Set hr_trust_up_to_share 1.05 (pace decides hard efforts) and cp_scale 0.97 to offset in-session blade-efficiency loss in late intervals. RESET cp_scale to 1.0 next session.

arguments.why: after last interval: review and decide cool-down guide

text: Pace decides above threshold where heart rate is pinned near its ceiling.

arguments.text: S3 min36: int4 (out, headwind) pace 1.04-1.10, HR 0.98-1.06 (HR peak 173.6). int5 (back, gusty tailwind) pace 1.20-1.37 (195-216 W, implausible for tired paddler: computer under-estimates tailwind push) but HR only 160-166 -> HR held down/eased. Rest minutes at 50 spm: HR ~0.52, pace ~0.49-0.52 (agree). Cool-down 38-43: agree mode, cp_scale reset 1.0. Lesson: gusty wind on back leg makes pace over-read hard efforts.

text: Cool-down reads from both routes with no scale adjustment.

Warm-up 52 spm: HR 0.56 vs pace 0.57-0.62 at zero current (0.51 with +0.04). Expect heat to raise HR + grow creep: after first turn use route_gap to set hr_offset / extra creep or go pace_first.
